1.why: The UI uses a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable line height and ample whitespace, though letter spacing is standard rather than especially generous.

2.why: No italics appear and all-caps is limited to the 'NORTHSTAR BANK' / 'SECURITY CENTRE' brand labels, while instructions themselves are short sentence-case paragraphs.

3.why: The single-column, phone-width layout with stacked labelled fields and full-width buttons stays readable and well organised at mobile size.

4.why: Most instructions are one line of plain language (e.g., 'Enter the six-digit code generated during setup'), though the demo box adds jargon such as 'short-lived challenge' and 'controlled test mode'.

5.why: Example placeholders are shown for the mobile number (+15551234567) and recovery code (ABCD-EFGH-JKLM), but the identity verification code and authenticator code fields display no example.

6.why: The user must scan the dense monospace Logs block to obtain the identity and authenticator codes, and that block grows into a long wall of text across the flow.

7.why: No copy button or export option exists on any screen, and step_05 explicitly instructs the user to enter the 33-character setup secret manually.

8.why: Authenticator setup offers only the manual secret ('add it manually to your authenticator app') with no QR code or equivalent alternative anywhere.

9.why: Code fields are plain text inputs with no one-time-code autofill hints, and nothing indicates browser autofill or password-manager support.

10.why: Each screen has a bold step heading and a single solid-blue primary button that clearly stands out from secondary elements.

11.why: Enrolment screens ask for one action at a time, but the login screen pairs 'Verify and continue' with 'Get a simulation challenge' and the MFA settings page presents generate, verify, and log-out actions together.

12.why: Some actions produce plain banners ('Setup secret generated. Enter it manually in your authenticator app.'), but requesting a challenge and verifying a recovery code only append a line to the technical log.

13.why: Back links and retries exist, but there are no reveal/hide controls and generating replacement codes permanently invalidates all previous codes, which is a penalty for re-requesting.

14.why: No error state appears in any of the 14 screenshots, so there is no observable evidence of how error messages state the problem and fix without blame.

15.why: The identity challenge is explicitly described as 'short-lived' and TOTP codes rotate quickly, with no visible countdown, extension option, or generous entry window.
